tasks.task: Inspect this repository and list the major packages/apps and briefly explain what each one does. Do not modify any files.

Add a trivial test file at packages/profiler/test/hash-simple.test.ts that imports sha256Hex from src/hash.ts and asserts it returns a 64-character hex string for input 'hello'. Ensure pnpm --filter @rapture/profiler test passes. Do not modify other files except adding the test.

Extend packages/profiler/src/redact.ts to also redact headers matching 'x-api-key: <value>' case-insensitively, and ensure existing tests in packages/profiler/test still pass. Run pnpm --filter @rapture/profiler test to verify.

Add a new CLI subcommand 'rapture runs stats' in apps/cli/src/cli.ts that prints total run count and average operations per run by reading .rapture/runs. Ensure pnpm --filter @rapture/cli build succeeds. Do not break existing commands.

Implement a new function computeWasteCategory in packages/profiler/src/analysis.ts that classifies a run's operations into waste categories (useful, duplicate, failed) and add a test file packages/profiler/test/waste.test.ts that verifies it. Ensure pnpm --filter @rapture/profiler test passes.

Fix packages/profiler/src/storage.ts so that loadRunTrace handles missing traceVersion gracefully by defaulting to '1' instead of throwing. Add a test that verifies loading a trace without traceVersion still succeeds. Ensure pnpm --filter @rapture/profiler test passes.
